waystations.name: Waystation A — The Cut
waystations.local_problem: Soot from the old rail yards coats every filter membrane black. Kessel swears he can taste coal dust in the drinking water now — and nobody tells him he's wrong.

waystations.name: The Switchback Waystation
waystations.local_problem: The scree slope behind the southern bunkhouse shifts a few inches every week. Vane marks the cracks in the wall with chalk each morning — the chalk lines keep getting wider.

waystations.name: Span 44 Rail Waystation
waystations.local_problem: The bridge abutment sinks another centimetre every hard frost. Taggart's crews shore it with railway sleepers, but the river is patient and the concrete is not. One more bad winter and the crossing goes.

waystations.name: Verity Motel Staging Post
waystations.local_problem: The deep well pump seized up on fine sand that shouldn't be there — Corvo thinks someone poured it in deliberately, and she keeps a loaded crossbow behind the counter while she tries to prove it.

waystations.name: Lock Gate Four Maritime Staging
waystations.local_problem: The sluice gate valve is welded shut by salt crust an inch thick. Renn chips at it every low tide with a hammer that's losing its handle, and the sea undoes her work twice a day without apology.

waystations.name: Verge Silo Waystation
waystations.local_problem: The garrison sentries want a bigger cut of every grain shipment. Orlov argues the numbers at the weighing plate each dawn, and each dawn the sentries' rifles get a little more casually pointed at the silo door.

waystations.name: South Beacon Lamp Post
waystations.local_problem: The seaward reflector is pitted, so the beam scatters instead of carrying. Vail has ground two replacements from salvage and neither holds a polish. Until one does, the lamp lights the yard and not the road.

waystations.name: Tinker's Notch Swap Post
waystations.local_problem: A claim was struck at the drop shaft and two crews are working it on the strength of two different marks. Vant has read both doorframes aloud twice. The registrar is eight days out and neither crew will wait.

waystations.name: Brine-Pan Hollow Waystation
waystations.local_problem: The east pan's assay came back low twice running and Vos will not sell a sack until she knows why. Either the brine is thinning or somebody is cutting the cure, and she has not decided which is worse.

waystations.name: Slate Hollow Enclave Post
waystations.local_problem: The lab is three sheets of shielding lead short and the quarry roof will not wait on a delivery. Marr offers assay work to anyone who can carry plate up the scree, and has had two takers and one arrival.

waystations.name: Iron Siding Redoubt Post
waystations.local_problem: A Garrison patrol walks the yard perimeter at dusk now, unhurried, and the Coalition cannot be seen to answer to it. Kesk keeps the shutters and the schedule, and the schedule has an hour in it nobody sleeps.

waystations.name: The Weighbridge Freight Post
waystations.local_problem: Two consignments arrived on the same receipt number and one of them is not on the manifest. Vale has filed both and weighed neither, which is correct procedure and also why the queue stands out into the yard.

waystations.name: Pilgrim Switchbacks Waystation
waystations.local_problem: The upper landing has washed out twice this season and the Walk will not stop for it, so the crossing is a rope and a decision. Drej has posted odds on the rope and, as always, does not intend to collect.

waystations.name: St Brigid's Almshouse Post
waystations.local_problem: The spring still runs clean, which is the only reason anyone walks out here, and the almshouse has four beds against eleven names on the tag board. Alderney is not turning anyone away and has run out of floor.
